.. include:: ../device_includes.rst

=========================================
Disclaimer
=========================================

.. warning::

    Secure Provisioning (Key as well as Code) is an atomic process which needs to be done in a controlled environment.
    In case of any failure due to environmental or electrical issue, may lead the device into a non-recoverable state from User as well as TI.
    Hence it is recommended to ensure the sanity of the setup throughout the provisioning flow.
